name: malayalam
description: Write, proofread, translate and transliterate Malayalam (മലയാളം) correctly. Teaches Claude modern Malayalam orthography and Unicode hygiene (atomic chillus, ZWJ/ZWNJ, ന്റ, ൗ), register and politeness, Kerala-specific conventions for dates, numbers and place names, and Manglish-to-Malayalam conversion. Includes /manglish, /proofread-ml and /translate-ml commands and a Malayalam Unicode normalizer script.
